# Mimir Mentor

> > Mimir Mentor is an AI-powered academic writing assistant offering literature research, scientific writing, plagiarism detection, and proofreading tools for German-speaking students and researchers.

Mimir Mentor provides comprehensive support for academic writing workflows, from thesis topic discovery to final plagiarism checking. The platform integrates AI writing assistance, access to 200M+ academic sources, and GDPR-compliant plagiarism detection across multiple disciplines including computer science, engineering, medicine, and business studies.

## Key Topics

- AI writing assistant
- Plagiarism detection
- Literature research
- Scientific writing
- Thesis writing
- DSGVO compliance
- Free tools
- Text correction
- Source management
- Academic writing
- Paraphrasing
- Citation management
- AI-text detection
- German language
- Master thesis

## Core Features

- [Themen-Finder: 10.000+ Themen für Abschlussarbeiten](https://mimir-mentor.com/thema-finden): AI-powered thesis topic finder with 10,000+ subject-specific examples across multiple disciplines
- [Literaturrecherche](https://mimir-mentor.com/literaturrecherche): Literature search tool accessing 200M+ academic sources for comprehensive research
- [Wissenschaftliches Schreiben](https://mimir-mentor.com/wissenschaftliches-schreiben): AI writing assistant for scientific and academic text composition with paraphrasing capabilities
- [Rechtschreibprüfung](https://mimir-mentor.com/rechtschreibpruefung): Free spell-check and grammar correction for academic texts with style and citation error detection
- [Plagiatsprüfung](https://mimir-mentor.com/plagiatsspruefung): GDPR-compliant plagiarism and AI-text detection tool for academic integrity verification

## Feature Details

- [Literaturrecherche - Features](https://mimir-mentor.com/features-literatur): Literature research feature page with 200M+ source access and advanced search capabilities
- [Wissenschaftlicher Editor](https://mimir-mentor.com/editor-mimir): Scientific writing editor with AI paraphrasing, source finding, and composition assistance
- [Korrektur Features](https://mimir-mentor.com/features-korrektur): Proofreading feature for grammar, style, and citation errors in academic documents
- [Plagiate Detection](https://mimir-mentor.com/plagiate): Plagiarism detection and AI-text identification tool with detailed similarity reports
